author: ankitvashisth
quote: So I have played this game for about 50+hrs and honestly It did great job on graphics and world BUT for me the story matter most and story is just utter garbage, WHAT A BORING JASON IS, he is literally more boring than my real life. The story just ****, okay i get the first hours feels like home simulator but later mission is not to the standard of what used to be in vice city, 3, 4 ,5 eras, its simply is not. Although if anyone simply wants to drive around and move around then yeah its a good game, little improvement from GTA 5. Its like GTA 5.5. I think in my opinion a pretty decent game but for me story is everything, idc about free roaming thing, its not my thing, if story is bad, thats pretty much over for me. Nevertheless, buy if you want to drive cool cars or go to insides of buildings and roam around.
